scope_note: Service-scoped exclusions for TrackSpense Cloud Run services ONLY. Never modifies unrelated services in the shared GCP project.

exclusions.name: exclude-trackspense-raw-cloud-run-requests
exclusions.description: Exclude raw Cloud Run HTTP request logs (which carry raw URLs, queries, and client IPs) for TrackSpense services while retaining native Cloud Run metrics and normalized app JSON events.

residual_boundaries: Sink exclusions control destination retention/routing only; they do not prevent initial Google Cloud platform request processing or retroactively purge historical log buckets.
Cloudflare edge logs and any inherited organization-level sinks must be audited separately before claiming full end-to-end exclusion.
